'''Phaaral''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was stationed in the [[Kwenn system/Legends|Kwenn system]] during the [[Eradication Day]]. During the attack by the [[Eradicator (weapon)|Eradicator weapons]] the personnel tried to abandon the burning station, but Phaaral threatened to [[Death/Legends|kill]] any deserters attempting to flee.
